messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO burn-rate alert triggered: service=redwood-inference-prod, burn_rate=3.4x over 5m vs budget. Paging policy: PAGERDUTY -> oncall. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/1782319000
Ava (oncall): oncall Ava here, picking this up. seeing the alert, pulling in logs and dash.
Mike (sre): any customer-facing errors/latency?
Ava (oncall): short summary: 5m spike in 500s on text-gen endpoints in eu-west-1. error rate jumped from ~0.1% to ~1.8% for last 10m. median p95 latency up from 120ms to 680ms. looks correlated with a burst of large-context requests (seq_len ~8k).
Jess (oncall-2): hmm could be batch/kvcache pressure + long sequences. any autoscale activity?
Ava (oncall): autoscaler triggered two extra nodes but queue backed up before instances warmed. I see repeated retries from clients X-correlation-id: abc123 in logs. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:14:02Z ERROR inference-handler request_id=abc123 model=chat-xl seq_len=7900 status=500 "kv cache OOM"
2026-03-14T12:14:05Z WARN  router     request_id=abc124 route=eu-west-1 fallback=false latency=650ms
```
Kevin (eng-platform): we should avoid paging for single-window spikes. propose: make 5m window a non-paging warning and page on multi-window sustained burn (30m and 1h). also add a per-customer-tier SLI so high-volume customers don't trigger global pages.
Jess (oncall-2): agree. current rule pages on 5m burn_rate > 2x. that's noisy. changed criteria in past got us paged for model warmups.
Mike (sre): suggested rule (quick draft):
```yaml
- alert: SLOBurnHigh
  expr: burn_rate(slo_error_ratio[5m]) > 2
  labels:
    severity: warning
  for: 0m
- alert: SLOBurnSustained
  expr: burn_rate(slo_error_ratio[30m]) > 1.5
  labels:
    severity: page
  for: 15m
- alert: SLOBurnCritical
  expr: burn_rate(slo_error_ratio[1h]) > 1.2
  labels:
    severity: page
  for: 30m
```
Mike (sre): the idea: 5m = noisy signal -> warn only; 30m+ sustained triggers pages.
Ava (oncall): for immediate noise reduction, I'm muting the 5m page rule and bumping it to warning. planning to create a silence for 1h for pagers on that rule.
Jess (oncall-2): please post the silence command so ops docs reflect it.
Ava (oncall): muting via alertmanager API:
```bash
curl -XPOST https://alertmanager.redwood.ai/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"SLOBurnHigh","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-14T12:18:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-14T13:18:00Z","createdBy":"Ava","comment":"temporary mute during triage"}'
```
Kevin (eng-platform): also recommend adding model-level fallback routing to reduce error surface: route long seq_len requests to quantized-fast variant rather than default heavy model. quick routing rule in router config:
```json
{
  "match": {"seq_len_gt":6000},
  "route_to": "chat-xl-fast-quant",
  "sticky": false
}
```
Lia (product): is there customer impact on SLAs? Any customers filing tickets?
Ava (oncall): so far no PD-1 tickets. telemetry indicates small subset of enterprise customers saw degraded throughput; will notify Customer Success if sustained. no data exfiltration.
Mike (sre): logging: open a short-lived dashboard panel for burn by customer and model to confirm targeted impact. link me when ready.
Ava (oncall): created quick dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/9b8/slo-burn-triage (panel: burn-rate by customer-tier, model, region). added timeframe 1h/6h/24h.
Jess (oncall-2): good. next: we should update runbook to reflect new paging criteria and multi-window policy. I'll open PR to ops/alerting with the YAML changes and runbook edits.
Ava (oncall): mitigation done: scaled up dedicated pool in eu-west-1 by +2 GPUs and applied routing fallback for seq_len>6k. error rate trending down to 0.35% in last 10m.
Mike (sre): perfect. can we make the 5m-->warning change permanent? or at least until we add customer-tier SLI?
Kevin (eng-platform): file action items:
- PR with alert rules + tests (owner: Jess)
- Dashboard (owner: Ava)
- Router rule + canary (owner: Kevin)
- Notify CS for affected customers (owner: Lia)
Ava (oncall): adding tasks to thread and will link PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/472
Jess (oncall-2): putting reviewer tags @kevin @mike.
Lia (product): please include suggested communication template for CS.
Ava (oncall): handoff time: I have to go offline at 13:00Z. Jess, can you take the handoff? current state: alerts muted for 1h, routing fallback active, scaled +2 GPUs, dash up, error rate decreasing.
Jess (oncall-2): taking handoff. will monitor for next 2h and escalate if burn_rate > 1.5x on 30m window.
Mike (sre): note for post-incident: revisit SLO burn budget policies. multi-window approach seems reasonable: short windows for observability, mid/long windows for paging. also add per-customer budget override to prevent noisy tenants from paging org-wide.
Ava (oncall): agreed. will add to postmortem: link to incident timeline and proposed alert changes.
incident-bot: Incident closed: no active pages. Follow-up tasks created in ops tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/issue/IN-3345 :eyes:
Ava (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: will file final postmortem and link back here.
Jess (oncall-2): thanks, handing over monitoring.
Kevin (eng-platform): LGTM on changes, let's schedule a short working session to codify multi-window testing.
Lia (product): thanks all, I'll prep customer comms template once PR lands.
